language: JavaScript (ES modules) for frontend, Python for backend
build_system: npm for frontend (vite build), Python virtual environment for backend
test_framework: None explicitly configured (manual verification via browser and API testing)
test_command: Manual: npm run dev (frontend) and uvicorn main:app --reload (backend), then browser testing
verification_instructions: 1. Start backend: cd Backend && uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000. 2. Start frontend: cd Frontend && npm run dev. 3. Open http://localhost:5173 and verify Delhi is default city. 4. Test city switcher, map view, scenario simulator, wards view, and AI advisor. 5. Verify all Delhi NCR references appear correctly.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None that are committed to version control
environment_constraints: Windows environment. Redis may need to be running for backend streaming features. WAQI, OpenWeather, Gemini API keys required in Backend/.env. Frontend VITE_MAPTILER_KEY required in Frontend/.env.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md or AGENTS.md found. Changes are additive and non-breaking. All changes maintain backward compatibility.
key_patterns: Frontend uses view-based architecture with modular HTML partials loaded into slots. Backend uses FastAPI routers with async endpoints. City data flows: config.js defaultCity -> main.js loadCityData() -> dashboard.js fetches from backend /twin/{city}/current. Map coordinates stored in CITY_CENTRES objects. Backend CITY_SLUGS map cities to WAQI station identifiers.
directory_structure: Frontend/src/ contains lib/, views/, components/, styles/. Frontend/public/partials/ contains modular HTML. Backend/app/ contains core/, models/, routes/, services/. Backend/ingestion/ handles Redis streaming.
